subject: Re: Proposal: Nexera SI Cohort — Skill Swap & Embedded Jumpstart
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexera.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: 6-week "Skill Swap" cohort to train Nexera SIs on Redwood runtime

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at the alliance summit — your talk around predictable inference economics landed well with our delivery leads. We discussed internally and want to propose a lightweight 6-week "Skill Swap" cohort to get a first wave of Nexera SIs comfortable with Redwood Dedicated and Private deployment patterns. High level: weekly 90-minute technical sessions (hands-on), two shadow co-deliveries with Redwood engineers, and a capstone lab where Nexera teams run a small POC for one of their customers.

Key asks from our side: a starter playbook for onboarding SIs, a short runbook for private deployment pitfalls, and a shadow engineering slot for weeks 3 and 5. I've attached a draft agenda.

Are you the right person to scope this, or should I loop in someone from partner enablement? We have a target start window the week of Aug 14 to align with our EU cohort.

Best,
Samir Patel
Partnerships & Delivery Lead, Nexera Consulting
O: 415-555-0186

Attachment: Nexera_SI_SkillSwap_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 92KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexera.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 6-week "Skill Swap" cohort to train Nexera SIs on Redwood runtime

Hi Samir — great to hear from you and glad the summit sparkled. Thanks for the concise agenda, this looks actionable.

Yes — I'm the right contact for program scoping, and I'll co-design the technical curriculum with our Solutions Engineering team (looped). Quick answers:
- We can deliver the 6-week structure; recommend making week 2 a dedicated "ops, scaling and KV caching" session to get the most unit-cost wins early.
- Shadow co-deliveries are doable — we'll commit an SE for two half-days (weeks 3 and 5) if we land scope by Jul 20.
- We'll provide a 1-page private deployment runbook and a lightweight playbook extract suitable for Nexera trainers.

Can you confirm cohort size (number of Nexera SIs) and whether the capstone POC requires access to a sandbox cluster (we can provision guest tenancy on Redwood Dedicated)? Also, which timezone for the weekly 90-minute sessions — we can do staggered US/EU-friendly times.

Proposed next step: 30-minute scope call Thursday (Jul 7) at 10:00 PT. If that works, I will invite Soojin and Jonas from Partner Programs to cover enablement logistics and materials.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 628-555-0147

-- On Jul 5, 2028, at 09:12, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexera.com> wrote: (see above)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Nexera SI Cohort — internal planning notes

Vanessa / Jonas — quick internal note while we prep for Thursday's call.

Items to confirm before the call:
- Cohort size: 8-12 SIs (ask Samir to confirm).
- Sandbox access: recommend offering a 2-week Dedicated sandbox with sample datasets (sanitized). Ops to define cost cap and access expiration.
- Materials: we should reuse the new "embedder derby" lab but produce a shorter 45-minute trainer kit and a 60-minute hands-on lab for the cohort.
- Success metrics: 70% of SIs able to run a full inference pipeline end-to-end in the capstone lab; post-cohort eval survey target NPS >= +30.

Jonas — can you check availability for SE shadow slots weeks 3 and 5 (roughly Aug 28 and Sep 11) and whether we can pre-approve them for 4 hours each? Also looping product docs to see if we can surface the private deployment runbook as a gated playbook.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Partner Enablement, Redwood Inference

From: Oktavia Chen <oktavia@nexera.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexera.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Nexera SI Cohort — updated agenda and questions

Hi Vanessa / Samir,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Couple of updates from Nexera:
- Cohort expected size: 10 SIs (two delivery teams).
- Preferred weekly time: Tue 10:00 PT (works for our US team; we'll run a separate EU repeat session if needed).
- Capstone: yes, we will need a sandbox with a small redwood-dedicated tenant and a sample dataset.

I've attached an updated agenda with session owners and outcomes, and a short extract of the Nexera trainer playbook to help with alignment.

If we get your thumbs up by Monday (Jul 11), we'll lock internal approvals and confirm the first session for Aug 14.

Thanks,
Oktavia Chen
Director, SI Enablement, Nexera Consulting

Attachments: Nexera_SI_SkillSwap_Agenda_v1.pdf (updated) ; redwood-embed-play-extract.docx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Nexera SI Cohort — logistics and calendar

Samir / Oktavia — love the updated agenda, good level of detail. Officially green across Partner Programs and Solutions Engineering. A few logistic notes before we lock dates:

1) Sandbox provisioning: we'll spin up a Dedicated guest tenancy for the cohort with an 8-hour-per-day access window for the capstone week. Security will generate short-lived creds and we'll provide an SSH/console runbook.
2) Session cadence: Tue 10:00 PT (90 minutes) starting Aug 14, repeat for 6 weeks. We'll record live sessions and drop them in a shared Drive folder for replay.
3) SE shadow days: Jonas confirmed two half-day blocks on Aug 28 and Sep 11 — I'll add tentative calendar invites and we can firm up exact times.
4) Materials delivery: expect the trainer kit and 1-page private deployment runbook by Jul 18; final slide deck + labs by Aug 7.

Next steps: I'll post an invite for the July 7 scoping call for completeness, but since the approvals are internal we can move forward. I'll also upload the Redwood trainer kit extract to the Drive link and share the HubSpot deal record for tracking.

See you on the call (or we can surface follow-ups asynchronously).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
